def _match(node, pos, cont, text, captures, fail_memo):
    """
    Try to match `node` starting at `pos` in `text`.
    `cont(new_pos)` is called if the node matches up to new_pos.
    Returns True if a complete match is found (cont eventually returns True).
    
    `captures`: dict mapping group_num -> (start, end) or None
    `fail_memo`: set of (quant_node_id, pos) for quantifier give-up failures
    """
    if isinstance(node, _Lit):
        if pos < len(text) and text[pos] == node.ch:
            return cont(pos + 1)
        return False
    
    elif isinstance(node, _Dot):
        if pos < len(text) and text[pos] != '\n':
            return cont(pos + 1)
        return False
    
    elif isinstance(node, _Class):
        if pos < len(text) and _class_matches(node, text[pos]):
            return cont(pos + 1)
        return False
    
    elif isinstance(node, _Start):
        if pos == 0:
            return cont(pos)
        return False
    
    elif isinstance(node, _End):
        if pos == len(text) or (pos == len(text) - 1 and text[pos] == '\n'):
            return cont(pos)
        return False
    
    elif isinstance(node, _Empty):
        return cont(pos)
    
    elif isinstance(node, _Concat):
        return _match_concat(node, 0, pos, cont, text, captures, fail_memo)
    
    elif isinstance(node, _Alt):
        return _match_alt(node, 0, pos, cont, text, captures, fail_memo)
    
    elif isinstance(node, _Group):
        return _match_group(node, pos, cont, text, captures, fail_memo)
    
    elif isinstance(node, _Quant):
        return _match_quant(node, pos, cont, text, captures, fail_memo)
